button.label: Check Ownership
button.supertip: Read-only. Fill the Serial cell on the Actions sheet, then click. Summarizes every ownership record for that serial.

button.label: Batch Lookup by Serial
button.screentip: Look up a column of serial numbers
button.supertip: Prompts you to select a column of serials, then writes an Asset Lookup Results sheet. Failed rows are shaded red - those are unknown, not empty.

button.label: Batch Lookup by DCN
button.screentip: Look up a column of DCNs
button.supertip: Same as batch serial lookup, filtered by Dealer Customer Number. One DCN usually owns many assets, so expect several rows per input.

button.label: Add / Update
button.screentip: Add or update one ownership record
button.supertip: WRITES TO PRODUCTION CCAT. New records require Ownership Type, Model and Model Year. On an existing record, only the fields you fill are updated - blank fields are left out of the request entirely.

button.label: Expire
button.supertip: WRITES TO PRODUCTION CCAT. Removes the ownership record. Expiring a PENDING record cancels its transfer request. Asks to confirm first.

button.label: Approve / Reject
button.supertip: WRITES TO PRODUCTION CCAT. Set Status to APPROVED or REJECTED on the Actions sheet. A reason is required to reject. No DCN is used for this endpoint.

button.label: Build Actions Sheet
button.supertip: Run once per workbook. Builds an Actions sheet with labeled input cells for the buttons in this group.

button.label: Run Batch
button.screentip: Add or update every row on the Batch Add-Update sheet
button.supertip: WRITES TO PRODUCTION CCAT, one row at a time. One confirmation for the whole batch. Each row gets a colour-coded result: green ok, red failed, yellow skipped. Add/update is idempotent, so failed rows are safe to re-run.

button.label: Build Batch Sheet
button.screentip: Create the Batch Add-Update input sheet
button.supertip: Run once per workbook. Builds the sheet with the right column headers and an Ownership Type dropdown.

button.label: Settings
button.screentip: Set the proxy URL and function key
button.supertip: Stored per-user in the Windows registry, not inside this add-in file. Each person enters their own; the key is never distributed with the .xlam.
